title: Beep twice
prompt: The robot beeps to get attention. Write `beep`, which prints "beep", and call it twice from `run` so "beep" appears two times.
hints: Once a function exists you can call it as many times as you like.
Define `func beep():` with a single print, then write `beep()` on two separate lines in run.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
